services.desc: The Port of Alsea has purchased the Dock of the Bay. The Port already owned the building and the marina and has now purchased the business. We have promoted a Dock of the Bay employee, to manage the boat rental and store. While there are a few changes being made, for the most part, the Dock of the Bay will look and operate has it has in the past. Whether renting a boat or purchasing bait for your crab rings, the Dock of the Bay will be here to serve
